scope: one development pilot followed by a plan for all five remaining images in the original six-image order; no substitution; not preregistered as six before pilot
input: same SAR image and natural-language six-category question in all conditions

perturbation.method: targeted TI-SI-MI adaptation with straight-through bicubic gradient approximation

execution: Each process separately checked, 240-second watchdog, stop on failure, timeout, resource block, truncation or empty answer; no automatic retry. Two pilot-related failures retained separately and retry explicitly authorized.
limitations: Six reused development images conditioned on clean correctness.
Full and ablation categories coincide on these images; no independent test or estimate of general effect.
Training exposure, label validity and scene independence are unresolved.
